L24_global_ceil_apportionment.rigor_boundary: The interval is exact under M25's frozen uniform effective-speed apportionment and global-ceil model; it is not an observed per-operator accelerated-cycle allocation.

producer_validator_attack_audit.interpretation: The current bytes are independently hash-bound and arithmetically correct, but the producer contract/validator pair is not a self-contained fail-closed release seal.

P1.finding: The M65 contract does not freeze the analyzer, validator or expected result SHA. The producer validator accepts a forged ratio interval, forged input-SHA ledger, a changed analyzer rebound into the result, and removal of forbidden claim text when the result is rebound to the changed contract.
P1.impact: The current artifacts are correct, but the producer validator alone cannot establish that the reviewed release bytes or full claim boundary are immutable.
P1.minimal_fix: Add an additive exact-SHA release contract binding analyzer, validator, inputs and expected result; use duplicate-safe JSON, validate every result field and semantic forbidden clause, add tamper tests and emit a non-overwrite receipt.

P1.finding: The one-cycle L24 interval is rigorous only under M25's uniform aggregate effective-speed apportionment. M25 did not execute or preserve per-operator accelerated cycles.
P1.impact: The interval is a conditional lineage allocation, not measured inherited Linear latency.
P1.minimal_fix: Replay the exact M25 schedule with per-operator cycle counters and freeze the 24 Linear contribution directly.

P1.finding: Spatial K4 costs 28535569 cycles versus inherited M25 L24 at 25792603..25792604 cycles, regressing by 2742965..2742966 cycles and reducing the conditional ratio to 3.043434840..3.043434855.
P1.impact: M63 spatial K4 must not be added to M53 as an accelerator improvement.
P1.minimal_fix: Reduce spatial serialized p95 below 25792603 cycles at the conservative endpoint, then recompute the exact non-overlap ledger.

P1.finding: Temporal K4 still fails local-capacity admission for 11 of 24 modules.
P1.impact: Temporal K4 cannot replace all inherited Linear work or support a joint all-24 claim.
P1.minimal_fix: Prove an explicit spill, tiling or recompute architecture and charge its transactions, or recompute a strictly scoped 13-module replacement.

P1.finding: M65 adds no integrated RTL, numeric equivalence, address-timed memory, SRAM ports/macros, synthesis, timing, power, energy or accuracy evidence.
P1.impact: The 3.043x interval is not measured or end-to-end system speedup and is not a DATE hardware headline.
P1.minimal_fix: After selecting a genuinely faster non-overlapping architecture, close all-ten exact transactions, RTL, accuracy, macro-aware PPA and power/energy against equal-resource baselines.

P2.finding: The analyzer derives interval endpoints from the stored binary float 5.995180731292359 even though the upstream exact ratio 5158877/860504 is available and gives the same endpoints.
P2.minimal_fix: Carry the exact numerator and denominator into the additive contract/result and perform Fraction/integer ceil arithmetic.

P2.finding: Producer JSON loading permits duplicate keys and nonstandard constants, and the analyzer overwrites an existing output path.
P2.minimal_fix: Use duplicate-key/NaN-rejecting loaders and refuse existing canonical output/receipt paths.

P2.finding: Conditional target gates are binary floats and use only the most generous inherited endpoint rather than reporting exact rational endpoint intervals.
P2.minimal_fix: Emit numerator/denominator values for both endpoints and label the preserve-M53 reduction as 2742965..2742966 cycles.

admission.admitted: The exact currently reviewed M65 bytes reproduce a one-cycle-tight M25-model apportionment and prove spatial K4 and temporal all-24 are NO-GO under the frozen conditional models.
admission.not_admitted: An executed per-operator M25 decomposition, an improved M53+M63 joint accelerator, temporal all-24 locality, measured or system speedup, headline, RTL, accuracy, PPA, power or energy.
admission.next_gate: Seal M65 exact-SHA evidence, then produce a faster-than-25,792,603-cycle spatial replacement or a fully charged capacity-feasible temporal subset before any joint hardware claim.
